# vengtoo_subject_attribute (Resource)

Manages an Vengtoo subject attribute definition — the schema for an ABAC attribute that policy conditions can read off a subject.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Attribute key, as referenced by a policy condition's field (e.g., department). Required — the update API treats an empty name as "unchanged", so it cannot be cleared.
- `type` (String) Attribute value type: string, int, bool, enum, object, or json. Required — the update API treats an empty type as "unchanged", so it cannot be cleared.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Attribute description.
- `enum_options` (List of String) Permitted values, for type = enum.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether subjects must carry this attribute.
- `subject_types` (List of String) Subject types this attribute applies to: user, service, device, custom, or ai_agent. Omit to apply to all.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Subject attribute ID.
